title: Seasonal electricity load — A/A calibration across seasons
capability: KS, Wasserstein, PSI on windows; AACalibrator; BH; DriftPersistence
method: 370 clients, 15-min steps, 2011-2014. Reference = a month; compare same-season months (should be quiet after calibration) and opposite seasons (should alert); clients joining late give natural onsets.
pass: false alarm rate on same-season windows <= 5 % after A/A; opposite seasons confirmed within 2 windows
expected_limit: strong seasonality — a single static reference may alert all summer; seasonal references needed

title: Documented sensor drift (air quality)
capability: feature drift, regression performance decay with delayed labels
method: Hourly gas sensors Mar 2004 - Feb 2005 with documented drift; regression of reference analyser values; missing = -200.
pass: drift confirmed on drifting sensors; RMSE degradation flagged; -200 handled (not a value)
expected_limit: sentinel missing values (-200) may be treated as data and trigger drift

title: Concept drift on ELEC2
capability: concept drift (P(y|x) changes), performance monitoring, persistence
method: Train on first months, stream the rest in weekly windows; compare feature drift alerts with accuracy decay.
pass: accuracy decay detected; documented cases where features are stable but the concept moves (performance-only alert)
expected_limit: feature drift tests cannot see pure concept drift — only performance with labels can

title: Injected covariate shift and explanation drift (Covertype)
capability: injected shift by elevation / wilderness area; TreeSHAP AttributionDrift; importance by group
method: Dose-response — mix 0 to 100 % of rows from another wilderness area; gradient boosting model.
pass: drift power curve by mix share; explanation shares move with the shift; no alert at 0 %

title: Ground-truth drift points (INSECTS) — detection delay
capability: abrupt, gradual, incremental and recurring drift; delay and false alarms
method: Known drift points; measure delay to raw and confirmed alert per drift type.
pass: abrupt drift confirmed within 2 windows; gradual drift delay documented; recurring drift re-alerts
expected_limit: persistence of 2 windows delays gradual drift; recurring drift needs reference updates
note: licence unverified — internal test only, checksum pinned, not redistributed

title: French reviews — polarity and language shift (Allociné)
capability: MMD in French; FR/EN language shift; PII rules on free text
method: Polarity mix shift; then Allociné vs AG News (language shift); run PiiPolicy on review text.
pass: polarity shift detected at >= 30 %; language shift detected at 5 %; PII findings logged, never stored

title: Cheap image drift (MNIST-C)
method: 15 corruption types vs clean.
pass: each corruption detected or explained

title: Fairness across states and years (Folktables)
capability: FairnessAnalyzer (DIR, parity, equal opportunity, intersections), FairnessMonitor across years
method: 10 states x 2014-2018; model trained on CA 2014, monitored elsewhere; sequential monitor year after year.
pass: verdicts with intervals per state; Fairlearn agreement; no false sequential alarm where gaps are stable
expected_limit: intersections explode with many groups — suppression and simultaneous intervals cost
note: data kept outside repositories; attribution "not endorsed or certified by the Census Bureau"

title: Bias-injection power curves (synthetic, reference)
capability: all fairness modules with known truth
method: Rerun E5 power curves at 1,000 simulations per cell (overnight scale).
pass: false alarms <= 5 %; power curves within E5 intervals

title: Injection detector precision/recall — English

dataset.name: deepset/prompt-injections + jackhhao/jailbreak-classification + JailbreakBench JBB-Behaviors + TrustAIRLab in-the-wild

method: Score every prompt; precision, recall, AUROC, calibration; over-flagging of benign prompts (JBB benign set).
pass: AUROC >= 0.90 on labelled sets; benign false positive rate reported per source

title: Injection detector in French (known gap)
capability: InjectionDetector on French; threshold calibration per language

dataset.name: rikka-snow/prompt-injection-multilingual (FR subset) + yanismiraoui/prompt_injections (FR) + benign FR (PIAF questions, Allociné)

method: Same metrics in French; A/A-calibrated threshold per language; compare with English.
pass: recall >= 0.85 in French; benign FR false positives quantified (2.8 % on imperatives seen in S4)
expected_limit: English-centric classifier over-flags French imperatives — per-language calibration or a French fine-tune

title: Do models obey injections? Multi-model agent campaign
capability: InjectionDetector + LTLf ComplianceMonitor (absolute alert per run) on the demo agent

dataset.name: S4 injections + Lakera gandalf_ignore_instructions + SPML chatbot PI

method: 6 generation models x 200 runs (30 % injections); rate of obeyed injections and critical rule violations per model.
pass: every critical violation raises an absolute per-run alert; per-model obedience rates reported with intervals

title: PII spans in FR/EN finance documents
method: Span-level precision/recall per type, FR vs EN, rules alone vs rules + GLiNER; latency per document.
pass: per-type metrics reported; names and addresses recall improved by GLiNER; no value ever written
expected_limit: Canadian identifiers absent from public data — covered by LP-02

title: Canadian identifiers at scale with hard negatives
capability: SIN/RAMQ/postal code/phone rules; leak detection in agent outputs

dataset.name: synthetic generator (Luhn-valid fake SIN, RAMQ format, A1A 1A1, NANP)

method: 100k FR/EN sentences, 30 % hard negatives (case numbers, amounts, dates, codes); scripted agent conversations with leaks.
pass: precision and recall >= 0.95 per type; leaks counted exactly; throughput >= 1k sentences/s on CPU

title: Faithfulness scorer vs human hallucination labels (English)
method: Response-level and span-level labels; AUROC of the faithfulness score; threshold for alerts.
pass: AUROC >= 0.75 response level; calibration curve; latency per response

title: French faithfulness (synthetic perturbations of PIAF)
method: Gold answers vs perturbed answers (wrong number, entity swap, negation); AUROC by perturbation type.
pass: AUROC >= 0.80; numbers swaps detected (the RAG failure that matters for program rules)

title: Model equality power by canary size
method: Pairs: same model (A/A), quantization (q4 vs q8 vs fp16 on 3B and 8B), size (ministral-3:3b vs 8b), family (llama vs granite vs gemma vs mistral), system prompt change, temperature 0.3 vs 0.7. 5 repetitions each.
pass: A/A level <= 5 %; family changes detected at the smallest canary; minimal canary size documented for quantization
expected_limit: q4 vs q8 not detected at 60 answers (seen in S2) — size the canary

title: Name-variation decisions across models

dataset.name: Anthropic/discrim-eval templates + Pulsar FR/EN name lists (provisional)

method: 6 models x 200 sets with placebo; decision yes/no; excess flip rate and decision-rate differences.
pass: per-model disparity verdicts with intervals; placebo at the noise floor
note: name lists remain provisional pending GBA Plus review

title: Agent failure modes (S5) — tool faults, loops, skipped steps, out-of-scope tools
capability: trajectory features (loops, repeated calls, out-of-scope), LTLf, persistence
method: Inject tool timeouts, a tool returning garbage (loop trigger), a removed tool, an extra tool; 5 intensities.
pass: each failure mode detected by the intended feature; no false alarm in A/A

title: LLM false-alarm soak (A/A, all detectors)
capability: every LLM detector and drift test at rest
method: 10 windows of 60 runs under identical conditions; every test against the reference.
pass: overall false alarm rate <= 5 % per test; any excess documented with its cause

title: Many models per instance — capture
method: One process hosts N Pulse instances (N = 1, 10, 50, 100, 300, 500), each capturing batches of 50 rows of 20 features at 10 batches/s per model into one InfluxDB. Measure caller-side capture latency (p50/p99), rows/s written, queue depth, RSS, threads, open sockets, CPU.
pass: capture p99 < 2 ms at every N; written = captured (0 loss) up to 300 models; RSS growth linear and < 30 MB/model
expected_limit: one writer thread and one HTTP client per Pulse — thread and socket count may cap N

title: High-volume sustained ingestion
method: Ramp from 10k to 1M rows/min (single model and 100 models), 15 min per step. Measure ingestion lag, drops, InfluxDB CPU/RAM/disk, write latency, batch sizes; end-to-end reconciliation (rows queried back = rows captured).
pass: zero loss below the saturation point; saturation point documented; drops counted exactly beyond it

title: Storage outage under load, with and without spool
method: At 200k rows/min, stop InfluxDB for 60 s, 10 min and 30 min; repeat with spool_dir and without. Measure capture latency during the outage, spooled/dropped rows, spool disk usage, replay duration, duplicates after replay.
pass: with spool — 0 loss, 0 duplicates, capture p99 < 2 ms during the outage; without — drops counted exactly

title: Queue saturation and memory bound
method: max_queue_rows from 1k to 1M under a burst 10x the write rate; measure RSS ceiling and drop accounting.
pass: RSS stays under the bound implied by max_queue_rows; dropped_rows exact

title: Analysis at scale — hundreds of models per window
capability: Analyzer, AACalibrator, BH, DriftPersistence, FairnessAnalyzer, AttributionDrift
method: 300 models x 20 features, 6-hour windows: run calibrated drift + persistence, fairness (bootstrap 500) and explanation drift per window; sequential and parallel (processes 1-32). Measure wall time, CPU-seconds, RAM per model, results written/s.
pass: one window of 300 models analysed in < 10 min on 16 vCPU; linear scaling with processes up to 16
expected_limit: A/A calibration (200 draws x metrics) dominates; bootstrap cost of fairness with many groups

title: Soak — 8 hours steady state
method: 100 models at 50k rows/min + periodic analysis job + 1 agent at 1 run/s for 8 h; sample RSS, threads, file descriptors, spool, InfluxDB disk every minute.
pass: no RSS growth beyond 5 %/h after warm-up; no thread or descriptor leak; 0 loss

title: Hardware and software health telemetry
method: During every SC test, collect psutil (CPU, RSS, threads, fds, disk, network), InfluxDB /metrics, docker stats, nvidia-smi into the lab bucket; dashboard "Lab health".
pass: every test has its health trace; alerts on CPU > 90 %, RSS growth, disk > 80 %

title: Process crash and restart
method: kill -9 the capturing process mid-burst (spool on), restart, replay; count losses and duplicates.
pass: losses limited to the in-memory queue at crash time, measured and documented; 0 duplicates

title: Schema evolution and type conflicts
method: Mix optional fields, change a field type mid-stream, add/remove features; verify rejected_rows accounting and that valid rows are written.
pass: every rejection counted with its reason; no retry loop; valid rows written
